question: Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: That there are no options for citizens (1) / when environmental breaches are overlooked by the ministry (2) / underline a deep failure in (3) / responsible governance. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contains an error in part **(3)**.
 
• The phrase "**underline a deep failure in**" is awkward and incorrect in its usage.
 
• The correct form should be "**underlines a deep failure in**" to agree with the subject in terms of verb usage.
 
• This grammatical correction ensures proper subject-verb agreement and maintains the overall clarity of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"That there are no options for citizens when environmental breaches are overlooked by the ministry underlines a deep failure in responsible governance."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1:** "That there are no options for citizens" – This part is grammatically correct and requires no changes.
 
• **Part 2:** "when environmental breaches are overlooked by the ministry" – This part is also correct as it is written.
 
• **Part 4:** "responsible governance" – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any modifications.
